QuestInfo.name: [Arteria] Discreet Choice
QuestInfo.1: Searching this whole ship on foot will take too long. Is there another way to find the Empress? Talk to #bEckhart#k in the #bBottom Deck Passage#k.
QuestInfo.2: Using Shinsoo's power, you were able to connect to the Empress's energy. You sense her faint voice coming from the top deck of the ship. Get up there and find her.
